install-torchvision.command: bash -c '/home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python -m pip install --no-input torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 2>&1; echo TV_EXIT=$?'

install-ipykernel.command: bash -c '/home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python -m pip install --no-input ipykernel 2>&1; echo IK_EXIT=$?'

nbexec2.command: bash -c 'cd /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/sandbox/me1-einops-einsum && /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python -m nbclient mnist_cnn_einops.ipynb --kernel onit --timeout 1800 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?'

nbexec3.command: bash -c 'cd /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/sandbox/me1-einops-einsum && /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python -c "import nbformat; from nbclient import NotebookClient; nb=nbformat.read(\"mnist_cnn_einops.ipynb\",as_version=4); NotebookClient(nb,kernel_name=\"onit\",timeout=1800).execute(); nbformat.write(nb,\"mnist_cnn_einops.ipynb\"); print(\"NB_DONE\")" 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?'

nbexec4.command: bash -c 'cd /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/sandbox/me1-einops-einsum && /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python -c "import nbformat; from nbclient import NotebookClient; from jupyter_client import KernelManager; km=KernelManager(kernel_name=\"python3\",executable=\"/home/edgardo.callagon.jr/.conda/envs/onit/bin/python\"); nb=nbformat.read(\"mnist_cnn_einops.ipynb\",as_version=4); NotebookClient(nb,kernel_manager=km,timeout=1800).execute(); nbformat.write(nb,\"mnist_cnn_einops.ipynb\"); print(\"NB_DONE\")" 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?'

gitpush.command: bash -c 'cd /home/edgardo.callagon.jr/sandbox/me1-einops-einsum && git add -A && git -c user.name="ercallagon" -c user.email="ercallagon@users.noreply.github.com" commit -m "Replace nn.CrossEntropyLoss with manual tensor-ops cross-entropy; re-execute notebook (test acc 96.02%)" && git push origin main 2>&1 | sed "s#//[^@]*@#//TOKEN@#g"; echo GIT_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}'
